prerequisites: Prior knowledge of the subject Graphic Expression is recommended.
It is advisable for students to have notions of sketching, fluent handling of drawing software, and skill in bibliographic consultation.

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent plans of engineering structures and installations.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards for the graphical representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications oriented to specific installations and drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and via the Internet.

syllabus_topics: Software CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation.
BIM Systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D models.
Exchange of drawing files between different computer applications.
Principles of dimensioning applied to industrial installations. Regulations.

assessment_methods.method: Exercises, work and/or presentations developed during the course (Individual project and its presentation)
Active participation of the student in the development of the subject. Correct completion of the exercises proposed during the course (Participation in presential classes and virtual campus)

assessment_rules: To be evaluated, students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (Classroom and Laboratory Practices); otherwise, they will be considered as 'not presented' in Continuous Assessment. The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * EV2 + 0.25 * EV4. If the established minimums are not met, the qualification will be the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must resubmit a personal work, either corrected/expanded or a new one. Differentiated evaluation allows participation via the virtual campus and submission of a personal work.
